subject: [PATCH 2/2] sched_ext: Specialize the scheduler hashtable compare

reviews.author: bot+bpf-ci@kernel.org
reviews.summary: Identified a potential code duplication issue between scx_sched_cmpfn() and scx_tid_cmpfn(), suggesting the use of a generator macro to avoid repetition.

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a new scheduler hashtable compare function, scx_sched_cmpfn(), to improve performance by specializing the comparison for sub-cgroup IDs. The function is added as an object comparison function in the rhashtable parameters, allowing for a single equality test against ops.sub_cgroup_id instead of emitting memcmp() for each element walked.
